title: [Discussion] Onboard cBTC (tacBTC) to Aave V3 Core and Aave V4 Core
headline: A forum post asks whether Aave should onboard tacBTC, the ERC-20 form of the cBTC token, to the V3 Core instance, the V4 Core Hub, or both.
summary: The author introduces cBTC, a BTC token on Ethereum live since 2026-09-18. To mint it, a BTC owner creates a lock on Bitcoin and a wstETH escrow of at least 1.5x the lock's value is posted; the owner keeps the key and no custodian holds the BTC. Bitcoin state is proven on Ethereum with zero-knowledge proofs. The post reports backing of 22,252,699 sats at a stated block. The lock is enforced economically, through a slashable escrow, rather than by Bitcoin script. Trust assumptions listed: Bitcoin and Ethereum consensus, the proof systems, a sync committee, Chainlink and Lido price feeds, and a 2-of-5 ops multisig with a one-hour delay acting within on-chain bounds. The post includes a comparison table against another BTC vault design. Risk parameters and final configuration would be left to Aave's risk service providers. Open questions: which instance, if any, and what risk parameters.
risk_flags: relies on multisig and price feeds
